literal_meaning: ছয় দিকে অর্থের লাপানো (money wasted in six directions)
figurative_meaning_en: Ultimate waste; wasteful expenditure of money
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পে ছয়লাপ হয়ে গেছে, কোনো ফল হল না।
তার ব্যবসায় ছয়লাপ করে সব টাকা শেষ করে ফেলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This project turned into a complete ছয়লাপ, with no results.
He wasted all his money in his business through sheer ছয়লাপ.
history: The idiom originates from the concept of money being scattered or lost in all six directions (symbolizing complete dispersion) without any productive work being accomplished, reflecting traditional Bengali views on fiscal prudence.
note: The idiom emphasizes futility in spending, common in colloquial Bengali speech.
